tones.name: First tone
tones.desc: High and flat, like holding a note.

tones.name: Third tone
tones.desc: Dips down low, then comes back up.

tones.name: Fourth tone
tones.desc: Sharp fall, like a firm command.

sandhi.title: Two third tones in a row
sandhi.explain: When one third tone is followed by another, the first becomes a second tone.

sandhi.title: 不 before a fourth tone
sandhi.explain: 不 is normally fourth tone, but changes to second tone before another fourth tone.

sandhi.title: 一 changes with what follows
sandhi.explain: 一 is first tone alone, becomes fourth (yì) before tones 1-3, and second (yí) before a fourth tone.

sandhi.title: Half third tone
sandhi.explain: Before any non-third tone, a third tone only does the falling half — it never rises back up.
